da-non-sequitur.evidence: [sidecar review 2026-11-15, issue #8030] Step 4 maps G^(2)\ | _F, which is generated by Li₂^q(z) for **all** z ∈ F^×, onto 𝔅(F) ⊗ ℚ. There is no such map: [z] lies in the Bloch group only for combinations in ker δ (z ∧ (1−z) torsion). So "dim = r₂" and "image = Bloch–Suslin image" are not established; the span of D(z) over all z ∈ F is not shown to be r₂-dimensional. "Injective after ⊗ℝ" holds for the Borel regulator into ℝ^{r₂}, not for a single D into ℝ/π²ℚ when r₂ ≥ 2.
